sn56.29:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ atthi ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyaṃ, atthi ariyasaccaṃ pahātabbaṃ, atthi ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ, atthi ariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ.
sn56.29:2.2: dukkhaṃ bhikkhave, ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyaṃ, dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ pahātabbaṃ, dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ.
sn56.29:3.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
